name: Product tags
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/product-tags", name: "Product tags", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The product's tags as badges.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Wrap(spacing: Space.xs, runSpacing: Space.xs, children: [ForEach(items: options.product.tags, as: "t", child: Badge(label: t, tone: Tone.neutral))])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "product", type: Product, required: true)],
)
